items.title: Flathub: beta branch never fetched, channel field unpopulated
Flatpak add-ons/extensions are deliberately excluded — revisit for user-relevant ones
Snap: only one channel per snap is captured, real channel-map has many more
Filter: drop test/hello-world snaps and other non-app noise (snapd fixtures, fortunes, injection-test package)
Nixpkgs: fetches nixos-unstable, not the stable numbered channel
openSUSE: only Tumbleweed (rolling) fetched, Leap (stable) never connected
Slackware: fetches -current (rolling), not a numbered stable release
Filter is far less effective on AUR/Arch than Debian/Ubuntu
catalog: add AppImageHub.com as a second AppImage source (OCS API works again)
